## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Yóuxīn fǎjiè jì* 遊心法界記 in 1 fascicle is [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's contemplative-philosophical treatise on the *mind's roving* (*yóuxīn* 遊心) in the *Avataṃsaka*'s *dharma-realm*. The text combines doctrinal exposition with contemplative-meditative direction: the bodhisattva's mind, taking refuge in the *dharma-realm*, traverses its boundlessness through ten stages of contemplative roving, each corresponding to a doctrinal articulation of the *dharma-dhātu*'s structure.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's mature period, c. 670 – 712 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The *yóuxīn* genre — the contemplative-philosophical companion to the larger doctrinal commentary — is one of Fǎzàng's distinctive literary innovations, paralleling the later *[Huán yuán guān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0090)* (T1876) but with a more philosophically-discursive cast.

The Taishō text (T1877) is established on the standard apparatus.
